what_it_is: AI security platform for AI usage control, agent security and app protection.

1.reason: Discovery and AI-BOM finds agents across cloud, CI and agent builders. AI Usage Control finds shadow AI.
1.evidence: Automatically identify every AI workload running in your cloud environments, along with new agents or configuration change
1.verify_note: Scraped Discovery page. Cloud, CI and agent builder discovery, shadow agents and SPM misconfig checks hold.
1.has: Discovery and AI-BOM covers Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Vertex and CI. AI-SPM checks.
1.lacks: No on-prem host or Kubernetes AI inventory found.

2.reason: Covers Copilot, Bedrock, Agentforce and Vertex agents. MCP discovery, risk scoring and open-source MCP gateway.
2.evidence: Whether you're building on Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot, AWS Bedrock, Salesforce Agentforce, or any other cloud or third-party service
2.verify_note: Scraped agents page. Vertex, Copilot, Bedrock, Agentforce named. MCP in AI-BOM. Inline pre-action enforcement on AI-DR page.
2.has: Covers Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex, Agentforce. MCP gateway.
2.lacks: No agent sandbox. Inline pre-action enforcement only.

3.reason: AI Detection and Response traces agent execution, blocks actions inline and streams findings to SIEM.
3.evidence: View alerts and audit logs directly in Lasso, or stream findings into your SIEM to investigate agent incidents
3.verify_note: Scraped AI-DR page. Inline block or quarantine and SIEM streaming both stated.
3.has: AI-DR traces agent execution, blocks actions inline, streams findings to SIEM.
3.lacks: Runtime signals only. No named SIEM or auto-remediation. No host blocking.

4.reason: Inline guardrails via API, firewall or AI gateway block injection, mask PII and moderate outputs.
4.evidence: Apply real-time guardrails at the moment of interaction that block malicious inputs, sanitize outputs, and enforce content policies
4.verify_note: Scraped app security page. API, firewall and gateway deployment. Blocks injection, moderates and sanitizes output.
4.has: Guardrails via API, firewall, AI gateway and browser extension block injection and PII.
4.lacks: Content moderation only. No hallucination or harmful code filter found.

5.reason: AI-BOM catalogs models and MCP servers. AI-SPM maps agents to OWASP, MITRE, NIST and EU AI Act.
5.evidence: Full coverage across OWASP, MITRE, NIST, the EU AI Act, and your internal policies.
5.verify_note: Scraped AI-SPM page. AI-BOM, OWASP, MITRE, NIST, EU AI Act mapping and audit trails hold.
5.has: AI-SPM maps to OWASP, MITRE, NIST and EU AI Act with audit logs.
5.lacks: AI-BOM has no standard-format export found.

6.reason: Automated AI Red Teaming runs multi-turn and tool-chain attacks, triggered from CI/CD on each update.
6.evidence: Lasso integrates directly with your CI/CD pipeline so red teaming simulations can run automatically on every application update
6.verify_note: Scraped red teaming page. 3000+ payload library, multi-turn attacks and CI/CD runs hold.
6.has: AI Red Teaming runs 3000+ payloads, multi-turn attacks and CI/CD runs.

7.reason: Flags overprivileged agents and enforces role-based MCP access. No NHI discovery product found.
7.evidence: Identify and categorize overprivileged or high-risk agents to stop dangerous usage patterns and reduce the attack surface.
7.verify_note: Overprivileged agent flagging holds. NHI search found only third-party guides, no Lasso NHI product.
7.has: Flags overprivileged agents and enforces role-based MCP access.
7.lacks: No per-agent cryptographic identity. No NHI discovery.

8.reason: AI-SPM statically analyzes agent design in code repos. Model risk assessment named, but no file scanning detail.
8.evidence: Identify misconfigurations, risky tool access, weak guardrails, exposed dependencies, and potential attack paths
8.verify_note: Static agent design analysis in repos holds. Model search found no file scanning. RAG CBAC is access control, not scanning.
8.has: AI-SPM statically analyzes agent code in repos. Model risk assessment.
8.lacks: No model file scanning detail. No dataset PII or poisoning scan.

notes: Platform splits into AI Usage Control, AI Agents Security and AI Application Security, with Intent Security (Intent Deputy) as the detection engine. Also covers coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) through lifecycle hooks, and ships an open-source MCP gateway. AI Model Risk Management appears only as a one-line component on the app security page. RAG context-based access control (earlier release) is the nearest dataset control. Lasso blogs describe agents as non-human identities, but no product page covers NHI discovery of service accounts, keys or OAuth grants. Two searches each for model scanning and NHI.
